meta.title: Chronik – campaign manager for D&D 5E
meta.description: Plan campaigns, weave storylines, manage characters and invite your group to game sessions – Chronik is the tool for game masters and their groups.

hero.title: Your campaign. Your world. In one place.
hero.lead: Chronik is the tool for game masters and their groups: plan campaigns, weave storylines, manage characters and invite to game sessions – from the first sketch of your world to the final encounter.
hero.demoHint: The demo shows an example campaign and needs no account.

screens.storyline: Act board of the storyline “The Mist Pact”: scenes as cards, connected by decisions and routes
screens.map: World map of Elaria with markers for regions and places and the location hierarchy next to it
screens.quest: Quest “The seal of the north gate” with rewards: experience points, gold, an item and reputation changes
screens.character: Character sheet of Arvel Merad with armor class, hit points, spell slots and abilities
screens.sessions: Planned sessions with date, place, content and the players' replies
screens.marketplace: Marketplace with monsters, places and adventure packs by other game masters

audience.title: Who is Chronik for?
audience.intro: For everyone at the table – each role sees exactly what it needs.

gameMasters.title: Game masters
gameMasters.text: Keep world, plot and rules in view and prepare sessions calmly – with everything you know in one place instead of scattered notes.

players.title: Players
players.text: See your character, shared discoveries and everything the game master reveals – on your computer or on your phone right at the table.

editors.title: Co-authors
editors.text: Work on the world and the compendium as an editor without the group seeing anything too early.

features.title: Everything your campaign needs
features.intro: Five areas carry your campaign – and work hand in hand.

campaigns.title: Plan campaigns
campaigns.text: Create campaigns with their own ruleset and build your world piece by piece: locations, people, factions and notes, all linked to each other.
campaigns.point2: Locations, people and factions with links
campaigns.point3: Drafts stay hidden until you reveal them

storylines.title: Weave storylines
storylines.text: Keep plot lines, quests and encounters together and see at a glance where your group stands and what may come next.
storylines.point1: Plot lines with chapters and quests
storylines.point2: Prepare encounters with monsters and treasure
storylines.point3: Reveal clues and secrets when the time is right

quests.title: Quests with rewards
quests.text: Create quests with quest givers, prerequisites and goals, and decide what the group gets for them.
quests.point2: Rewards with experience, gold, items and reputation
quests.point3: Visible to everyone, single players or the game master only

characters.title: Manage characters
characters.text: Player characters and NPCs by the rules of your campaign: species, class, background, feats, spells and equipment – with calculated values.
characters.point1: Character sheets with values, spells and equipment
characters.point2: Classes, subclasses and feats from the compendium
characters.point3: Players keep their own character up to date

sessions.title: Game sessions with invitations
sessions.text: Invite your group by email, plan the dates and run the session: your players see what you show them.
sessions.point1: Invite players by email and assign roles
sessions.point2: Plan sessions and follow up on them
sessions.point3: A player view for the table, mobile too

compendium.title: Compendium by ruleset
compendium.text: Spells, classes, species, feats, backgrounds and items – plus your campaign's own content.

reveals.title: Reveal on purpose
reveals.text: You decide when a location, a note or a person becomes visible – to everyone or to single players.

history.title: Nothing gets lost
history.text: Every change is recorded and can be undone.

languages.title: Multilingual
languages.text: German and English, with the terms of each ruleset edition.

marketplace.title: Share and discover content
marketplace.text: Find monsters, places and whole adventures by other game masters for your ruleset and add them to your campaign – or publish your own. Reviewed content is marked.
marketplace.demo: See the marketplace in the demo

cta.title: Ready for the next adventure?
cta.text: Try the demo, or create your account and set up your first campaign.
